column3: reason   (rows that curl cannot drive on the shared local stack; everything else is decided by recorded calls)

SSE handler commits 200 + headers before the usecase runs and discards the usecase error (sse_handler.go streamSession: `_ = h.stream.Stream(...)`), so the connection-cap/IncrConn 503 can never reach the status line; the cap itself is hard-coded to 1000 per instance (booking_module.go NewStreamSession(..., 1000)). Not driven at runtime (would need >1000 concurrent streams); see MISMATCH rows R030/R031 for the same mechanism observed live (unknown session / other visitor -> 200 with an empty stream).

The contract text itself says the body errorCode is currently VALIDATION_ERROR, not UNAUTHORIZED (status 401 decides). Observed 401 VALIDATION_ERROR on the same route (row R145 PASS), so there is nothing further to exercise for UNAUTHORIZED.
ACCOUNT_DISABLED needs a disabled account. No API disables an account and the brief forbids direct DB writes; a read-only query shows all 195 users.accounts rows are ACTIVE.
Same as R232 (refresh of a disabled account).

Logout 500 INTERNAL_ERROR requires the Valkey denylist write to fail; the only way is to break the shared Valkey cluster (forbidden: infra must stay untouched). A temporary instance cannot isolate it because the denylist is in the shared cluster.
